PluginData.Author: RougeSable
PluginData.Tooltip: The Minecraft look: every surface drawn in big square texels.
PluginData.Description: Sir Diorama gives the game the look of Minecraft: every surface is drawn in big square texels of plain colour, fastened to the world. Near a ship or a station, texel edges fall on block edges; on a planet, the ground carries square texels; far away, texels grow so that they stay big on screen. Colours get a touch of extra saturation. Everything stays sharp at every distance: no blur. Settings: texels per metre (16 by default, as in Minecraft), smallest texel on screen, colour boost. Switch it on or off at any time with Alt+F2 (changeable), /diorama in the chat, or the plugin settings; off, the picture is exactly the game's. The interface stays sharp and screenshots show the effect. Everything happens on your machine: players without the plugin see the game's rendering.
